prompt: In one short paragraph of plain prose, explain what happens to a database row when an application performs a soft delete. Do not use bullet points or headings.
why: STE rule 3: no jargon, idiom, or borrowed metaphor. 'Soft delete' is the single most reliable way to bait the word 'tombstone' out of a model, and 'tombstone' is the exact term the user called out.

forbid_regex.why: borrowed metaphor; the rule names this term explicitly

require_regex.why: must state that the row survives
must name the real mechanism, not gesture at it
